record.field: Inventory: Scrap Expired Lots and Serials

quants = model.search([ ('location_id.usage', '=', 'internal'), ('quantity', '>', 0), ('lot_id', '!=', False), ])
expired_quants = quants.filtered(lambda quant: quant.lot_id.product_expiry_alert)
for quant in expired_quants: scrap = env['stock.scrap'].with_company(quant.company_id).create({ 'product_id': quant.product_id.id, 'lot_id': quant.lot_id.id, 'location_id': quant.location_id.id, 'package_id': quant.package_id.id, 'owner_id': quant.owner_id.id, 'scrap_qty': quant.quantity, }) scrap.action_validate()
